title: Anethum Graveolens Uses, Benefits, And Remedies
intro: Anethum graveolens, commonly known as cumin, is an annual herb native to the eastern Mediterranean and South Asia, valued for its aromatic seeds and culinary uses. This herb is rich in bioactive constituents such as essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties. Health benefits include aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and supporting respiratory and cardiovascular health. It can be used in various herbal preparations such as infusions, decoctions, or as a spice in culinary dishes.
